comment: Copy this file to mcp_servers.json to enable MCP servers. The backend reads it on startup and (when enabled=true on a server) exposes its tools to the chat LLM through the normal tool pipeline. Nothing is contacted until 'enabled' flips to true; this file is safe to commit without live credentials.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Read-only access to the backend uploads directory.
